landmarks_tried_2026_10_14.note: Five extremal-feature landmarks (placed_by claude) from the silhouettes opened at 10/6 px. Scored against Chris's accepted dots (dot check, median canvas px): none 19.1; all five 21.4; best single (SW arm tip) 14.5; best triple (north cape, west cape, SW arm tip) 13.7. The 12 px bar was not met, and picking a subset by that score would leak the dots into the fit, so none ship. Silhouette extremes are CR/globe differences as much as features.

naggaroth._comment: Naggaroth (#8211). A mainland: scope is closed by cuts, a seed and a named island list (2026-10-14, Claude). Placement is by landmarks (fit.mode landmarks), scored leave-one-out: the CR frame's left edge crops the west coast and our canvas top crops the north, so a silhouette fit would fit the crops. The sweep affine over the shared central window (IoU 0.69, scale ~1.55 x 1.9) is the starting point; every landmark is a coast corner present on both coasts within 30 px under it.
